context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase C pages tested: ConfirmPage (/course/:courseId/confirm), LoadingPage (/course/:courseId/loading), EnrolledPage (/course/:courseId/enrolled). All pages receive data via React Router location.state. ConfirmPage expects {plan, answers, freeText, courseStructure, courseTitle} from PreviewPage - redirects to /customize if no plan. LoadingPage expects {courseTitle, enrollmentId} from ConfirmPage - redirects to course details if no enrollmentId, auto-redirects to enrolled after 3.6 seconds with 3 animated steps. EnrolledPage shows success with confetti animation, 'Start Learning' → /dashboard, 'Browse Courses' → /courses. All routes protected by ProtectedRoute. Data-testid attributes: confirm-heading, confirm-stats, confirm-modules, confirm-enroll-btn, confirm-modify-btn, loading-page, loading-course-title, loading-step-0/1/2, enrolled-page, enrolled-heading, enrolled-subtitle, enrolled-badge, enrolled-start-learning, enrolled-browse-courses. Fixed React warning in ConfirmPage by wrapping navigate() in useEffect.
notes: ConfirmPage elements verified from code review: 'Your Personalized Learning Path' heading, stats (modules/sessions count), module list, 'Confirm & Enroll (Free)' button, 'Modify' button.
